name: Houseki Doll ~Zakuro Seki~
source:
'After all, I can't choose between you two.'
A heartrending story about a doll with jewel eyes and a human high school girl who regains her sparkle.

One day before the depressing final examination, Hinata, the grandchild of the chairman of Hinagata Academy, met a delinquent boy at an arcade, who calls himself 'Garnet'.
"Then I'll call you what I want too. You will be 'Mr. Dracula", who was crazy about gaming."

Garnet was a delinquent who never went to school.
One day, he met Hinata, who, like him, hated her name.
"I'll go to school with you. But only if you avoid the red marks in English."

The closer he was to humans, the more he realized.
He was nothing but a doll, and he was different from them.

"I'm neither human nor doll, I'm..."

Then I can be me and shines next to her.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/3784]NovelGame[/url]]
